title: qRT-PCR Protocol
author: Liangtao Wu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i3pcgmn
materials: Put out the tubes from Real time PCR instrument(Bio-Rad，USA)and perform dissociation curve analysis with the saved copy of the setup file.
Exported the results to Excel software, and the expression values are calculated according to the ﻿2-ΔΔCT method.

steps.title: Prepare Primers and Reagents
steps.instruction: Retrieve gene-specific primers using Primer Premier 6.0 and National Center for Biotechnology Information Software, and prepare SYBR® Premix Ex Taq™ II (Tli RNaseH Plus) (TaKaRa, China) fluorescent dye.

steps.title: Verify PCR Specificity
steps.instruction: After the PCR is finished, remove the tubes from the machine and examine PCR specificity using a 3% agarose gel.

substeps.instruction: Use 8 ml from each reaction for the gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Analyze PCR Results
steps.instruction: Analyze the real-time PCR results using BioRadCFXManager software.

substeps.instruction: Check for any bimodal dissociation curves.
